Q: How to get ldcoe5viewer on windows system A:

Did you run pip list or pip freeze to see if sip was listed?

You also might have to install the specific version of sip for the version of QT.

QT 6: pip install pyqt6-sip

QT 5: pip install PyQt5-sip

Make sure that you are in the same Python environment as the one with sip installed while running it.

Another good option is to install it system-wide if you are on Linux.

Debian/Ubuntu: sudo apt install python3-sip

Q: Best way set up protected Route in react using JWT? A:

Typically tokens that expire contain their expiry date on the payload so you can easily decode them and check if the token expired and delete it if it did before you can attach it to your payload.

https://www.jwt.io/ is a good tool to examine the token to determine the best way to find out when it expires.

Q: How to define guild in discord.py? A:

member.guild in rewrite or member.server in async

discord.Member has a specific field which permits retrieving the guild.

Instead of channel = await find_channel(guild) just do channel = await find_channel(member.guild) assuming you're using rewrite version.
